title: answer-assessor config validator
description: Validates configuration inputs for the answer-assessor skill

transcript_path.description: Path to the Q&A transcript file

thesis_path.description: Path to the thesis document for cross-referencing answers

supervisor_review_path.description: Path to the supervisor review (to check if remarks were addressed)

external_review_path.description: Path to the external reviewer report (to check if remarks were addressed)

prepared_questions_path.description: Path to previously generated questions (from question-generator) for comparison

realtime.description: Whether the transcript is being updated in real-time
